answer_1.quote: Each agent acts as both speaker (receiving trajectories and describing them with utterances) and listener (receiving utterances and trying to induce the corresponding trajectories).
answer_1.outputs: Utterances (sentences) describing trajectories in a gridworld

answer_2.quote: Evaluation In both speaking and listening mode, sequences are generated by greedy decoding and evaluated by sentence-level accuracy. ... we report speaking accuracy, listening accuracy, as well as average utterance length across generations.
